en_title: GTA 6 Will Make The Game Awards Cutoff Date for Eligibility by the Skin of Its Teeth, Confirming It Has a Chance at 2026 Game of the Year
subtitle: 只差一天
opus_summary: TGA确认今年参评截止日为11月20日，《GTA6》目前定于前一天发售，有资格角逐年度游戏。提名尚未公布，去年《光与影：33号远征队》以九奖创下获奖纪录。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is officially in with a chance of winning the 2026 Game of the Year award at this year’s The Game Awards, after the show confirmed the cutoff date for eligibility.
paragraphs.cn: 随着The Game Awards（TGA）确认今年的参评截止日期，《GTA6》正式获得了角逐2026年年度游戏奖的资格。

paragraphs.en: According to a FAQ on The Game Awards website , to be in with a chance of winning an award a game must be released on or before Friday, November 20, 2026. GTA 6’s release date is currently November 19, 2026, which means it’s made the cutoff date by just a single day.
paragraphs.cn: 根据TGA官网的常见问题解答，游戏必须在2026年11月20日星期五当天或之前发售，才有资格参评。《GTA6》目前定于2026年11月19日发售，仅比截止日期早一天，刚好赶上。

paragraphs.en: Nominations for this year’s awards haven’t been announced yet, of course, but it’s hard to imagine a situation where GTA 6 doesn’t show up for most, if not all, the categories it’s eligible for. Sandfall Interactive's Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 holds the world record for the most wins at The Game Awards , taking home a whopping nine awards at last year's show. Will GTA 6 beat it?
paragraphs.cn: 当然，今年的提名名单尚未公布，但很难想象《GTA6》不会在符合参评条件的多数奖项中获得提名，甚至可能全部入围。Sandfall Interactive的《光与影：33号远征队》在去年颁奖礼上一举拿下九项大奖，保持着TGA获奖数量最多的世界纪录。《GTA6》能打破这一纪录吗？

paragraphs.en: And given GTA Online 2 or whatever the multiplayer mode ends up being called is reportedly due out next year, perhaps alongside a PC version , we could see GTA 6 back in contention at The Game Awards 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，据报道，《GTA Online 2》——不管这个多人模式最终叫什么名字——预计将于明年推出，或许还会与PC版一同登场。因此，我们可能会看到《GTA6》在2027年TGA上再次参与角逐。

paragraphs.en: While we wait for this year's nominations, we’ve got plenty more on GTA 6 for you to check out, including our in-depth interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson , our report on what sounds like the end of Cyberleek , and confirmation of GTA 6’s sweat system .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待今年提名名单公布期间，我们还有不少《GTA6》相关内容可供阅读，包括对Rockstar North的Rob Nelson的深度采访、有关Cyberleek似乎走到尽头的报道，以及《GTA6》出汗系统获确认的消息。
